name: tensorchain_mcp
summary: TensorChain (Tom-owned L1) connector — NFT mint / contract deploy / escrow settle / royalty split / balance query / tx broadcast. Three-backend resolution (RPC → cargo → stub). Most Rust-side methods are not yet implemented; STUB mode + cargo subprocess fallback + a SUI two-chain bridge keep the connector graceful while tensorchain-service grows. Every call crystal-anchors via inference_logger.log(tier='monetization', model='tensorchain'|'tensorchain_sui_fallback', scope='tensorchain_<tool>').
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass mirroring stripe_mcp + deepseek_mcp shape. SERVICE='tensorchain'. Connect() resolves backend in priority order: (1) TENSORCHAIN_RPC env → JSON-RPC 2.0 via stdlib urllib POST, (2) /data/Projects/gently/crates/tensorchain-service/Cargo.toml present → subprocess cargo run --bin tensorchain-service <method> <json> (timeout=120s), (3) STUB → SendResult(success=False, error='tensorchain unreachable: ...') with crystal anchor for audit. Tool dispatch via send(recipient=tool_name, message=json_args).

env_vars.TENSORCHAIN_RPC: JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint URL (http(s)://...) — primary backend. Note: keys.upstream_key('tensorchain') falls back to SUI_WALLET in auth/keys.py, but a wallet address is NOT a valid RPC URL — connector only accepts http(s):// scheme as RPC.
env_vars.SUI_WALLET: Read by keys.upstream_key for the parallel sui_mcp connector during two-chain fallback
env_vars.SUI_FALLBACK: Set to '1' to enable two-chain bridge: on JSON-RPC -32601 (method not found), route mint_nft / query_balance through sui_mcp (TROLLN package). Unset = strict tensorchain only.

two_chain_bridge.purpose: Tom's tensorchain L1 is in early Rust development — most methods (mint_nft, escrow_settle, royalty_split) are NOT yet implemented Rust-side. The SUI bridge lets the dApp keep shipping primitives by transparently falling back to Sui's TROLLN package for the subset of tools that have a Sui equivalent.
two_chain_bridge.activation: env SUI_FALLBACK=1 AND tool in SUI_BRIDGEABLE AND backend returned JSON-RPC code -32601 (or textual equivalent in stub/cargo output)
non_bridgeable: deploy_contract  — WASM only on tensorchain, no Sui Move equivalent here
escrow_settle    — tensorchain-native escrow program, no fallback yet
two_chain_bridge.audit_trail: When fallback fires, the InferenceRecord is logged with model='tensorchain_sui_fallback' (not 'tensorchain') so the audit chain distinguishes native vs bridged calls. metadata.sui_fallback_used=True in SendResult.
two_chain_bridge.import_safety: sui_mcp import is wrapped in try/except — if the SUI connector module is missing (e.g. parallel agent hasn't shipped it yet), the fallback returns SendResult(success=False, error='sui_fallback unavailable: ...') without crashing the call site.

substrate: studio/third_party/tensorchain/ (per-config persistence) + ~/.cc/third_party_logs/tensorchain_sends.jsonl (history) + ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl (crystal-anchored monetization records, tier='monetization'). Cross-references the gently Rust crate at /data/Projects/gently/crates/tensorchain-service/ READ-ONLY for existence detection.

inbound_callers: stripe_mcp webhook handler → escrow_settle on successful payment_intent (A.7 of plan)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: TENSORCHAIN_RPC via keys.upstream_key('tensorchain') + load_env; gently crate Cargo.toml existence check

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.mint_nft_real_invocation: cargo run invoked, rc=101 — expected: tensorchain-service binary not yet wired in gently workspace. Error surfaced cleanly without crash or hang.
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.stub_path: ok — forcing GENTLY_CRATE to nonexistent path resolves to stub; mint returns success=False with 'tensorchain unreachable' error
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.sui_fallback_runtime: ok — sui_mcp.SuiMCPConnector import succeeded (parallel agent shipped it), bridge call executed end-to-end and returned a real Sui RPC error from the network for the placeholder owner address

guarantees: Crystal-anchored — every call (success OR failure) has a deterministic InferenceRecord with tier='monetization'
Stdlib-only — urllib for JSON-RPC, subprocess for cargo, no pip deps
Graceful triple fallback — RPC → cargo → stub, never crashes, never hangs (cargo has 120s timeout)
Two-chain bridge — opt-in via SUI_FALLBACK=1, only on JSON-RPC -32601, audit-distinguishable via model='tensorchain_sui_fallback'
Read-only of gently — checks Cargo.toml existence but never writes into /data/Projects/gently/
Wallet-address-not-RPC guard — TENSORCHAIN_RPC must be http(s):// scheme; SUI_WALLET fallback in keys.upstream_key is ignored for RPC routing
usage_example:
from core.lib.third_party.tensorchain_mcp import TensorChainMCPConnector
c = TensorChainMCPConnector()
backend = c.connect()  # 'rpc' | 'cargo' | 'stub'
r = c.send('mint_nft', '{"metadata_uri":"ipfs://Qm...","royalty_bps":500,"owner":"0xabc"}')
print(r.metadata['tx_hash'], r.crystal_id, r.metadata['sui_fallback_used'])
